page_texts.3:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/arb-requirements.md#purpose]

## Purpose

The ARB review evaluates **logical design** documents to ensure technical solutions are complete, feasible, and align with enterprise architecture standards. This is a detailed technical review that occurs after CRB conceptual approval.

---
page_texts.5:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/arb-requirements.md#what-arb-reviews]

### What ARB Reviews

- **Detailed architecture design** (system, data, infrastructure, security, integration)
- **Technology stack decisions** with justifications
- **Technical risk assessments** with mitigation strategies
- **Operational considerations** (deployment, monitoring, disaster recovery)
- **Timeline and resource planning**
- **Compliance with security and regulatory requirements**
page_texts.6:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/arb-requirements.md#what-arb-does-not-review]

### What ARB Does NOT Review

- Business justification (already approved in CRB)
- High-level concepts without technical detail
- Documents focused primarily on business value rather than technical implementation

---
page_texts.7:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/arb-requirements.md#expected-content-style]

## Expected Content Style

- **Technical depth**: Deep technical details with diagrams, architectures, and specifications
- **Precision**: Specific technology choices, versions, configurations
- **Completeness**: All architectural domains covered (system, data, infrastructure, security, integration)
- **Actionable**: Sufficient detail for development teams to implement
- **Cohesive**: Flows logically from section to section, avoids redundancy
page_texts.8:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/arb-requirements.md#red-flags]

### Red Flags

- Missing or incomplete architectural diagrams
- Vague technology choices ("we'll use a database")
- No consideration of non-functional requirements
- Missing operational considerations
- Disconnected sections that don't form a coherent whole
- Excessive verbosity or duplicate content

---
page_texts.9:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/arb-requirements.md#scoring-dimensions]

## Scoring Dimensions

| # | Dimension | Weight |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Project Information & Completeness | 10% |
| 2 | Executive Summary & Context | 10% |
| 3 | Architecture Design | 30% |
| 4 | Risk & Quality Assessment | 20% |
| 5 | Operational Readiness | 15% |
| 6 | Timeline & Resources | 8% |
| 7 | Compliance & Standards | 7% |

> For detailed criteria, section mappings, and diagram requirements, see the [processing rules file](../../resources/processing-rules/arb-rules.json).

---
page_texts.10:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/arb-requirements.md#required-diagrams]

## Required Diagrams

1. **C4 Level 3 — Component Diagram** (System & Application Architecture)
2. **Logical Deployment Diagram** (Infrastructure Architecture)
3. **Data Model Diagram** (Data Architecture)
4. **Infrastructure / Network Architecture Diagram** (Infrastructure Architecture)

---
page_texts.11:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/arb-requirements.md#passfail-rules]

## Pass/Fail Rules

- **Overall weighted score ≥ 75%** → PASS (APPROVED)
- **Overall weighted score < 75%** → FAIL (REJECTED)
- Individual dimension scores are **informational only** — they do NOT independently cause rejection
- Per-section status shows ✅ PASS or ⚠️ CONDITIONAL for transparency, but the overall decision is driven solely by the overall score
